 FORECAST: Cloudy, cold, rainy Friday 
 By Tawana Andrew Published : Nov. 10, 2026 at 3:57 PM EST | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WEATHER HEADLINES 
 NEXT 12: Cloudy with highs in the 40s and scattered showers (some graupel may mix in with rain) 
 SHORT TERM: Sub-freezing lows Saturday morning; Areas of morning fog 
 LONG TERM: Sunny and chilly weekend ahead 
 LATEST FORECAST 
 LOUISVILLE, Ky. (WDRB+WAVE) — Cloudy skies remain overhead, with scattered showers expected throughout the day. Graupel (soft ice pellets) and snowflakes may mix in with the rain at times. Highs will rise into the 40s this afternoon, but wind chills stay in the 30s most of the day. 
 Once showers move out of the region this evening, clouds begin to clear, allowing temperatures to drop into the 20s and low 30s and fog to develop. With temperatures below 32°, freezing fog may lead to slick spots in some locations early Saturday. We’ll see a mix of sun and clouds on Saturday; more cloudy cover is expected in areas east of I-65. 
 Despite some sunshine in the forecast, it will still be cold to start the weekend; expect highs in the 40s. Mostly clear to partly cloudy skies remain Saturday night. Look for lows in the 20s and low 30s. 
 Mostly sunny to partly cloudy skies stick around on Sunday. Highs climb into the 40s and low 50s on Sunday afternoon.
